Under the hood How the model works + per-job results

One CPU, discrete integer ticks, known burst lengths, and no context-switch overhead. FCFS and SJF run a job to completion. SRTF, EDF and LLF reconsider every tick. Equal priorities break by arrival, then the order in your workload. Round Robin queues arrivals at a slice boundary before requeuing the running job.

Waiting = completion − arrival − burst. Turnaround = completion − arrival. Response = first start − arrival. A deadline is missed only when completion is later than the deadline. Missing deadlines have infinite priority. Switches count direct changes between jobs; idle transitions are excluded.
